flags.finding: The explicit depiction of Grandpa snorting cocaine and the subsequent mention of heroin use are highly likely to result in a blocked theatrical release in China. Chinese censorship aims to promote 'positive energy' and strictly prohibits content that promotes or normalizes illegal drug use.

citations.title: In China, one actor's drug arrest can jeopardize an entire film - Los Angeles Times
citations.excerpt: China’s State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television issued a missive in September saying that celebrities who use drugs or hire prostitutes should be banned from TV and film screens. Entertainers, the censorship agency said, ought to “spread positive energy” and “create a positive environment” on media platforms.

citations.title: Film censorship in China - Wikipedia
citations.excerpt: Endangerment of social morality, disturbing social order, undermining social stability; promoting pornography, gambling, drug use, violence, or terror; instigation of crimes or imparting criminal methods;

remedy.detail: Remove all explicit depictions of drug use (S008) and all mentions of heroin use (S028). This is a story-critical element for Grandpa's character, so cutting it would significantly alter the film's narrative and character development for this market.

flags.finding: Grandpa's explicit sexual comments (S028), homophobic slurs (S028, S041), and the request for and depiction of pornographic magazines (S041, S084, S086) are highly likely to result in a blocked theatrical release in China. This content directly violates Chinese censorship rules against obscenity, pornography, and content deemed immoral or promoting 'deviant sexual practices.'

citations.title: Pornography in China
citations.excerpt: Pornography is currently illegal in China. It remains one of the most heavily censored topics by the Chinese Communist Party.

citations.title: Film censorship in China - Wikipedia
citations.excerpt: In addition to crimes and insults to China, pornography was also one of banned contents. In 1932, the "Outline of the Enforcement of the Film Censorship Law" [[ note 4 ]]() had vague and ambiguous provisions: depicting obscene and unchaste acts; depicting those who use tricks or violence against the opposite sex to satisfy their lust; depicting incest directly or indirectly; depicting women undressed and naked

citations.excerpt: China's censors drop gay scenes from 'Bohemian Rhapsody' film

remedy.detail: Remove all explicit sexual comments, homophobic slurs, and references/depictions of pornographic magazines. This would significantly alter Grandpa's character and much of the film's comedic tone.

remedy.detail: Replace the specific negative dialogue or obtain a release from the United States Naval Academy for this specific usage. Alternatively, change the organization to a fictional one.

flags.finding: The screenplay contains 42 instances of "fuck" (or variations like "fucking", "fucked", "fuckers") and 1 instance of "bitch". This level of strong language significantly exceeds the typical guidelines for a PG-13 rating, which generally allows for only one non-sexual use of the "F-word". This will almost certainly result in an R rating.

citations.title: Using the F-word in PG-13/12A movies | Den of Geek
citations.excerpt: “Do you know that unless you’re willing to use the R rating, you can only say the ‘F’ word once? You know what I say? Fuck that. I’m done.” This refers to a guideline imposed by the Motion Picture Association of America, the US ratings board, which places a quota upon the number of F-words you can use in a PG-13 movie.

citations.title: How many F-bombs trigger an R rating? An obscure movie industry panel decides
citations.excerpt: Warner Bros.' "The Batman," for example, has a lot of profane dialogue, including the use of s---, b---- and a------. But it only used the F-word once, allowing it to remain PG-13.

remedy.detail: To achieve a PG-13 rating, all but one non-sexual instance of "fuck" and all instances of "bitch" must be removed or replaced with milder language. Prioritize removing instances from Richard, Grandpa, and Dwayne in scenes S015, S018, S021, S028, S044, S050, S053, S058, S063, S064, S072, S088, S089, S090, S113, S119, S125, S127, S128.

flags.finding: The screenplay contains explicit depictions of illicit drug use. In S008, Grandpa is shown snorting a substance (implied cocaine) with a razor blade and rolled-up dollar bill, and experiencing its effects. In S028, there is explicit discussion of Grandpa snorting heroin. The MPA guidelines indicate that depictions of hard drug use, especially if graphic, contribute to an R rating.

citations.title: Ratings Guide - MPA Film Ratings
citations.excerpt: Rarely does Drug Use involve the use of hard drugs such as cocaine, heroine, crack, meth, LSD or other hallucinogens, Ecstasy, etc., although use of such drugs may be implied. Effects of Drug Use are not usually evident, but if they are, drugs are not glamorized or made to look fun.

citations.title: Ratings Guide - MPA Film Ratings
citations.excerpt: May also include any use of hard illegal drugs such as cocaine, heroine, crack, meth, LSD or other hallucinogens, Ecstasy, etc. May also involve prescription drugs used in a non-prescribed matter. Depictions of use and after-effects may be graphic (e.g., may see character cooking drugs and/or injecting drugs, snorting drugs, entering a state of euphoria or passing out or “tripping” or other effects after taking drugs. May also include Drug Abuse or Substance Abuse, depictions of which may be graphic in nature.

remedy.detail: To achieve a PG-13 rating, the explicit depiction of Grandpa snorting drugs in S008 must be removed or significantly softened to mere implication, and the explicit mentions and discussions of heroin use in S028 should be removed or changed to refer to a less illicit or less severe substance.

flags.finding: The screenplay contains significant sexual content. In S028, Grandpa makes explicit and crude sexual comments to Dwayne, a minor, including references to 'fuck her', 'fuck a lot of women', and 'jailbait'. In S041, Grandpa explicitly requests 'porn' and uses a derogatory term ('fag-rags'). Scenes S084 and S086 depict pornographic magazines with suggestive titles and descriptions. This combination of explicit sexual dialogue, particularly directed at a minor, and the clear depiction of pornographic material, will result in an R rating.

citations.title: Ratings Guide - MPA Film Ratings
citations.excerpt: May include Sexuality, Sexual References, Sexual Material or Sexual Content of a more adult nature. Sexual References may be direct, crude, profane, graphic or explicit.

citations.title: Ratings Guide - MPA Film Ratings
citations.excerpt: Sexuality or Sexual Content may include sexual activity that is depicted in a somewhat realistic or graphic manner. May contain nudity, including graphic nudity.

remedy.detail: To achieve a PG-13 rating, all of Grandpa's explicit sexual comments in S028 and S041 must be removed or significantly softened. The request for 'porn' and the derogatory term in S041 should be removed. The depiction and explicit mention of pornographic magazines in S084 and S086 should be removed or replaced with generic, non-explicit magazines.
